jobs.title: Associate Creative Director, Design
jobs.descriptionText:
Noodle is higher education's leading strategy, services, and technology partner. Our Associate Creative Director, Design is a creative leader who shapes the work, elevates the team, and brings ideas to life at every stage of the process. This is a role for a strategic creative who thinks in brand systems and narratives, not just deliverables.

As our Associate Creative Director, Design, you will: Drive brand and identity work across a range of initiatives -- from institutional rebranding and advancement campaigns to athletic identity systems -- championing typographic craft, layout sensibility, and visual hierarchy at every scale, whether the deliverable is a digital ad unit or a comprehensive brand system. Bring a storyteller's instinct to all video and photo work -- leading productions from concept through post-production. Lead end-to-end creative campaign development. Proactively research design trends, cultural shifts, and competitor activity -- translating those insights into creative strategies, while driving adoption of modern tools, including AI-assisted workflows, to improve throughput and unlock new creative possibilities.

Leadership & Collaboration: Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of designers, art directors, and video producers. Collaborate closely with cross-functional marketing teammates -- including media managers, editors, copywriters, and strategists.

You have: 7+ years marketing experience; higher education experience preferred. 5+ years of experience managing a design team, preferably at an agency. Bachelor's degree in design or corresponding field. Knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite and Figma.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Client Media Solutions
jobs.descriptionText:
Real Chemistry is looking for an Associate Director, Media Activation to join our growing team! The Associate Director, Media Activation is responsible for campaign strategy, planning, execution and management while also overseeing and coaching Managers and Associates on the same accounts.

What you'll do: Lead tactical strategy and planning for campaigns from a brief. Manage a team of Managers/Associates. Experienced campaign manager who can train the team to build campaigns in buying platforms, perform QAs and activate according to best practices. Collaboration across all agency teams (Integrated Media, Analytics, Strategy, Ad Operations, Creative, etc.) is required.

What you should have: 5+ years of professional experience working in digital media as a campaign manager. 3+ years hands-on direct / experience managing direct sites / publisher buys. Experience in platform strategy and tactical recommendations. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint & Word.
